name: Move dictation-review consent gating behind deterministic validation and rate limits
description: Root cause verified on origin/main 08d75f4: POST /dictation/review asserts LLM consent before its atomic rate-limit and aggregate prompt-budget exits, although only an accepted request that reaches reviewDictation/routeAndCall needs provider consent. Withdrawn consent therefore masks deterministic 429 and 413 outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria:
Definition of done (source baseline: origin/main 08d75f4):

1. Consent ordering and externally visible variants
- Invalid request-schema input still returns the existing 400 before handler execution.
- A rate-exhausted request returns the existing 429 even when LLM consent is withdrawn; no LLM provider dispatch occurs.
- A schema-valid request whose aggregate original+corrected+context prompt characters exceed MAX_DICTATION_REVIEW_PROMPT_CHARS returns the existing 413 even when consent is withdrawn; no LLM provider dispatch occurs.
- A rate-eligible, in-budget request that would reach reviewDictation/routeAndCall returns the existing consent-denied 403 when consent is withdrawn, before any LLM dispatch.
- With active consent, the accepted path still dispatches exactly once and preserves the existing review response and rate-limit semantics.

2. Boundary coverage
- Update apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.manifest.ts and apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts so the final dictation-review consent owner and ordering are structurally represented; the guard must fail if this LLM path becomes unclassified or can dispatch without a consent boundary. Metering remains route-owned and unchanged.

3. Regression proof
- Add focused regression cases in apps/api/src/routes/dictation.test.ts for withdrawn-consent 429, withdrawn-consent aggregate 413, and withdrawn-consent LLM-ready 403/no-dispatch. The regression test must fail against the production implementation with the fix reverted and pass with the fix present.
- Execute and record the focused red -> green -> production-revert red -> exact-restore green sequence with: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/mentomate_test pnpm exec jest --config apps/api/jest.config.cjs --runInBand --silent apps/api/src/routes/dictation.test.ts apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts
- Run routed validation with: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/mentomate_test bash scripts/check-change-class.sh --run --fast

4. Scope and authority
- Expected collision set: apps/api/src/routes/dictation.ts, apps/api/src/routes/dictation.test.ts, apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.manifest.ts, and apps/api/src/middleware/metering.coverage.guard.test.ts; touch dictation service/test files only if the selected boundary placement requires them.
- No schema, migration, prompt/model/provider-routing, payload/rate-limit policy, metering, or unrelated consent-policy change is authorized. If one becomes necessary, stop and obtain a separate ruling/item.
- Acceptance requires an exact-head strict-green Adversarial review because this is a P1 consent/security boundary change.
riskImpact: P1 privacy/control-order defect at an LLM boundary. Incorrect placement can either dispatch after withdrawal or change established 400/429/413 behavior and rate-limit side effects. The repair is bounded to one route flow plus structural coverage; no schema or policy change is required.
